rationale: Pulp-owned macOS plug-in host change. PulpGpuPluginView (plugin_view_host_mac.mm) no longer sets its CAMetalLayer drawableSize in -setFrameSize: or -viewDidChangeBackingProperties:; the frame that configures the swapchain sets it, and the layer uses kCAGravityTopLeft, so a drag keeps showing the last frame instead of an emptied layer between frames. A Pulp-owned host test checks the drawable size and layer contents across a resize. Only Pulp-owned host and test code changes; the render sources are untouched. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'a resize keeps the last frame until the next one draws'
